risks.title: Economic downturn vulnerability
risks.score_rationale: The company explicitly states: 'our business is cyclical and vulnerable to economic downturns and client spending reductions.' Demand for infrastructure services may be suddenly reduced by economic contractions.

risks.title: Increased competition
risks.score_rationale: Operating in a competitive professional services market with numerous competitors offering similar infrastructure consulting and design services creates pricing and margin pressures.

risks.title: Foreign currency exchange rate risk
risks.score_rationale: Company explicitly states: 'Given the global nature of our business, our revenue is exposed to currency rate fluctuations that could change from period to period and year to year.'

risks.title: Dependence on qualified workforce
risks.score_rationale: Company states: 'Our revenue is dependent on our ability to attract and retain qualified and productive employees.' As a knowledge-based professional services firm, human capital is critical to operations.

risks.title: Government contract risks
risks.score_rationale: Company mentions: 'government contracts are subject to audits and adjustments of contractual terms' and 'long-term government contracts are subject to uncertainties related to government contract appropriations.'

risks.title: Regulatory and compliance risks
risks.score_rationale: Company notes exposure to: 'changes in government laws, regulations and policies, including failure to comply with laws or regulations applicable to our business' and environmental compliance requirements.

risks.title: Reputational and quality risks
risks.score_rationale: As a professional services firm dependent on client relationships and brand reputation, 'maintaining the high quality of the work generated by our employees is integral to our revenue generation and profitability.'

ai_positioning.summary: AECOM mentions AI investments in the context of its future strategic initiatives and potential acquisitions (forward-looking statement). The company does not currently disclose substantial AI-based capabilities or services, but acknowledges the importance of AI in future strategic initiatives to enhance delivery capabilities and value proposition.
evidence: MD&A: 'risks associated with our strategic initiatives, including AI investments and potential acquisitions and divestitures'
